description.value: Harker's Organics is a fifth-generation family farm in Cawston, BC — billed as the Organic Farm Capital of Canada — featuring a fruit stand and retail market stocked with certified organic seasonal produce. The property also houses the Rustic Roots Winery & Cidery and an in-house Barn Door Bistro, making it a genuine multi-stop destination on Highway 3 through the Similkameen Valley. The farm is listed as a Harvest Hosts location, signalling a culture of welcoming travelling visitors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and corroborates the OSM record: phone (250) 499-2751 and address 2238 Highway 3 Cawston BC both match OSM tags. The site confirms an active fruit stand, retail market, Barn Door Bistro (hot food), and winery/cidery operation. No explicit mention of bike parking, water refill, or any cycle-specific infrastructure anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address uses 'Crowsnest Highway'; website uses 'Highway 3' — these are the same road, minor naming inconsistency only.
Website page title contains a typo: 'Harker's Oganics' (missing 'r'), though body text and OSM both use correct spelling 'Harker's Organics'.
Bike parking and water refill could not be confirmed from website content — a follow-up visit or call would resolve these required criteria.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active farm market with organic groceries and an on-site bistro on Highway 3 in the Similkameen Valley — a clear resupply and food stop of genuine value to touring cyclists on this corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Farm is listed as a Harvest Hosts location (visible in site navigation), which suggests they actively welcome overnight travellers and may be receptive to cyclist-friendly amenity additions.

Basic groceries.detail: Fruit Stand & Retail Market selling certified organic seasonal fruit and vegetables; bulk fruit & veg also available; weekly box delivery offered May–October

Hot food.detail: In-house Barn Door Bistro with its own menu listed on the website
